mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, reducing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) and elevated Fed rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal persistent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for two consecutive months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job growth exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% MoM) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past month indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales trend (RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars) signals strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with rising RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
